mapper.insert:
insert into t_mes_pmt_recipe( id, RECIPE_ID, MIX_AREA, RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE, RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE, RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME, RECIPE_VERSION_ID, RECIPE_TYPE, PRODUCT_STAGE, SUMMER_MIX_TIME, WINTER_MIX_TIME, LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT, RECIPE_STATE, AUDIT_FLAG, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME ) values
( #{item.id, jdbcType=DOUBLE} , #{item.recipeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.mixArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.recipeEquipCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.recipeMaterialCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.recipeMaterialName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.recipeVersionId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.recipeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.productStage,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.summerMixTime, jdbcType=DOUBLE} , #{item.winterMixTime, jdbcType=DOUBLE} , #{item.lotTotalWeight, jdbcType=DOUBLE} , #{item.recipeState,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.auditFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.delFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} , #{item.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{item.updateTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
on duplicate key update RECIPE_ID = values(RECIPE_ID) , MIX_AREA = values(MIX_AREA) , RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE = values(RECIPE_EQUIP_CODE) , RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE = values(RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE) , RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME = values(RECIPE_MATERIAL_NAME) , RECIPE_VERSION_ID = values(RECIPE_VERSION_ID) , RECIPE_TYPE = values(RECIPE_TYPE) , PRODUCT_STAGE = values(PRODUCT_STAGE) , SUMMER_MIX_TIME = values(SUMMER_MIX_TIME) , WINTER_MIX_TIME = values(WINTER_MIX_TIME) , LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT = values(LOT_TOTAL_WEIGHT) , RECIPE_STATE = values(RECIPE_STATE) , AUDIT_FLAG = values(AUDIT_FLAG) , REMARK = values(REMARK) , DEL_FLAG = values(DEL_FLAG) , UPDATE_BY = values(CREATE_BY) , UPDATE_TIME = now()
mapper.select: select , trt.recipe_type_name, tmi.machine_name from t_mes_pmt_recipe tmpr left join t_recipe_type trt on tmpr.recipe_type = trt.recipe_type_code and trt.del_flag = 0 left join (select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_mix_machine where del_flag = 0 union select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_lhfl_machine where del_flag = 0) tmi on tmpr.recipe_equip_code = tmi.machine_code and tmpr.mix_area = tmi.mix_area where tmpr.del_flag = '0' and INSTR(tmpr.recipe_material_name, #{recipeMaterialName}) > 0 and INSTR(tmi.machine_name, #{machineName}) > 0 and INSTR(trt.recipe_type_name, #{recipeTypeName}) > 0 and tmpr.recipe_state = #{recipeState} order by tmpr.create_time desc order by ${orderStr}

select , trt.recipe_type_name, tmi.machine_name from t_mes_pmt_recipe tmpr left join t_recipe_type trt on tmpr.recipe_type = trt.recipe_type_code and trt.del_flag = 0 left join (select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_mix_machine where del_flag = 0 union select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_lhfl_machine where del_flag = 0) tmi on tmpr.recipe_equip_code = tmi.machine_code and tmpr.mix_area = tmi.mix_area where tmpr.del_flag = 0 and tmpr.recipe_material_name = #{recipeMaterialName,jdbcType= VARCHAR} and tmi.machine_name = #{machineName,jdbcType= VARCHAR} and tmpr.RECIPE_STATE = '1' /*配方状态: 在用*/ and tmpr.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' /*审核标志： 已审核*/

select distinct tmpr.recipe_material_name, tmpr.recipe_equip_code, tmpr.mix_area, tmi.machine_name from t_mes_pmt_recipe tmpr left join (select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_mix_machine where del_flag = 0 union select mix_area, machine_code, machine_name from t_lhfl_machine where del_flag = 0) tmi on tmpr.recipe_equip_code = tmi.machine_code and tmpr.mix_area = tmi.mix_area where tmpr.del_flag = 0 AND tmpr.RECIPE_STATE = '1' /*配方状态: 在用*/ AND tmpr.AUDIT_FLAG = '1' /*审核标志： 已审核*/ and tmpr.recipe_material_name = #{recipeMaterialName,jdbcType= VARCHAR} and tmpr.mix_area = #{mixArea,jdbcType= VARCHAR}
